name: Peter Kropotkin
role: Russian anarchist communist theorist, geographer and revolutionary (1842–1921)
summary: Kropotkin advocated common access to wealth through voluntary, decentralised associations, rejecting capitalist ownership and state socialism. He treated mutual aid as a foundation of social development, sought integration of manual and intellectual work, and criticised prisons. His later record combines support for Allied resistance in 1916 with opposition to foreign intervention and party dictatorship in revolutionary Russia.

unions-good.rationale: He supports labour organisations as vehicles for direct worker struggle and social reconstruction.

property-fundamental.rationale: He calls for expropriating productive wealth and guaranteeing common access instead of private ownership.

state-harmful.rationale: His own exposition rejects the state as an institution sustaining monopoly and subordinating individual initiative.

empower-police-military.rationale: He demands removal of policing and penal authority rather than granting it additional coercive powers.

decide-locally.rationale: He advocates territorial and functional decentralisation and free federation built from local initiative.

open-borders.rationale: The manifesto explicitly affirms internationalism, union of peoples and the eventual disappearance of borders.

socialized-markets.rationale: He rejects collectivist exchange through labour notes, proposing free access to communal supplies.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: He rejects the wage system and labour notes in favour of communal provision.

one-party-rule.rationale: His March 1920 letter says party committees have displaced the soviets and destroyed their constructive energy.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: He explicitly opposes the state whether organised as a monarchy or a republic.

workers-councils.rationale: He praises worker and peasant councils controlling economic and political life, provided elections and the press remain free.

right-to-secede.rationale: He calls for recognising the independence of the former Russian Empire’s constituent territories and rejects coercive recentralisation.

political-violence-never.rationale: He explicitly defends tyrannicide and resistance to invasion as potentially morally justified.

direct-action.rationale: He urges labour organisations to struggle directly against capital instead of forming parliamentary parties.

means-match-ends.rationale: He tells Lenin that communist aims cannot justify hostage-taking and methods that reproduce the old order’s terror.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: He rejects permanent occupational separation while retaining temporary specialisation, integrating manual, intellectual, agricultural and industrial work.

distribute-by-need.rationale: He makes needs, rather than measured individual labour contributions, the basis of distribution.

production-for-use.rationale: He proposes organising production around everyone’s necessities rather than profitable luxury markets.

profit-exploitation.rationale: He describes capitalism as allowing owners to appropriate a disproportionate share of society’s production.

territorial-expansion.rationale: The manifesto demands rejection of annexations and economic subjection of invaded peoples.

reason-over-faith.rationale: He praises refusing authority and accepting no principle until reason establishes it, rejecting inherited religious commands.

state-class-instrument.rationale: He describes state organisation as the historical instrument establishing monopolies for ruling minorities.

night-watchman-state.rationale: He proposes replacing state functions with voluntary associations, rather than retaining a minimal compulsory government.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: His ethical argument demands reciprocal treatment and equality rather than privileges for oneself over other people.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: He argues that mutual aid contributes more to progressive social evolution than relentless competition among individuals.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: He expressly rejects the overpopulation explanation, arguing that productive capacity and social arrangements undermine Malthusian scarcity.

party-controls-media.rationale: He argues that workers’ councils cannot remain free when liberty of the press is suppressed.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: He opposed an immediate peace benefiting German imperial power and supported the resistance effort of the Allied populations.

death-penalty.rationale: He expressly rejects sending dangerous offenders to the gallows and proposes freedom and fraternal care instead.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: He treats inherited social wealth as belonging to all and available for everyone’s well-being.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: The manifesto rejects retaining conquest without inhabitants’ consent and calls for repudiating annexations.

character-from-environment.rationale: He identifies upbringing and social conditions as major causes of conduct, while also discussing inherited dispositions and illness.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: He rejects treating obedience to law as morality and urges replacing authority with freely developed social ethics.

local-production.rationale: He proposes regions producing and consuming most of their own agricultural and manufactured goods.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: He says formal access to professions cannot emancipate women without reorganising domestic labour.

socialized-care.rationale: He proposes common kitchens and organised household services to replace women’s isolated domestic toil.

cooperative-communities.rationale: He advocates integrated communities combining agriculture with socially organised industrial production and community-owned equipment.

suppress-opposition.rationale: He condemns imprisoning political opponents as hostages and threatening their execution as retaliation.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: He argues that state-supported capitalist monopoly prevents people freely developing their faculties and productive activity.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: He calls for demolishing prisons and dispensing with judges, policemen and informers in favour of practical solidarity.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: He defends lethal resistance to invaders and rejects an absolute ban on killing.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: He says councils lose their significance under party dictatorship and calls for producers themselves to direct reconstruction.

municipal-property.rationale: He advocates communities taking possession of productive resources and arranging their use collectively.

confederal-coordination.rationale: He proposes freely constituted local groups federating regionally and internationally without a governing hierarchy.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: In 1916 he supported continued Allied resistance, rather than refusal to fight all interstate wars.

automate-paid-work.rationale: He advocates labour-saving machinery and reorganised production so necessities require substantially shorter working days.

notes: Read the complete statement list against downloaded books and essays across economic, political, ethical, technological and international themes. Positions come from his own arguments rather than an anarchist label. The 1916 co-signed manifesto is retained despite the controversy it caused; later criticism of intervention in Russia is recorded separately. Regional production is not an endorsement of a closed imperial trading bloc. Common housing is not a demand for every family to own its dwelling, and criticism of patents alone does not establish the combined patents-and-copyright statement. General opposition to state authority is not used to manufacture positions on each specific modern civil law. The Western Europe letter is headed April 1919 in the consulted transcription, with an editorial note giving English publication in July 1920. No inferred answers were needed. Opposition to central bureaucracy does not rank central planning against markets, both of which he rejected. His Russian non-intervention demand is not broadened into the statement’s exceptionless rule.
